images.filename: First arrivals at Manus Island Airport (8204043801).jpg
images.caption:
The first group of irregular maritime arrivals arrived at the regional processing centre in Manus Island, PNG today.

The 19 people, comprising families from Sri Lanka and Iran, departed Christmas Island late yesterday. Transfers to Manus Island and Nauru will continue in coming weeks and months.
